item.name: VAENAIT BABY Bamboo Modal Dino Animal Kids Pajamas Set 6M-12Y Long Sleeve Soft Sleepwear 2pcs
item.title: VAENAIT BABY Bamboo Modal Dino Animal Kids Pajamas Set 6M-12Y Long Sleeve Soft Sleepwear 2pcs
item.description:
🌞Vaenait baby is a top apparel brand in South Korea founded in 1995, and selling in the world 
'Vaenait' is a special and traditional clothing in South Korea gifted to a newborn baby praying for good luck and health then cherished for a lifetime as regarded "Lucky Clothing".
Vaenait baby is responsible for a whole process to give the value of "Delivering Good Luck to all Customers"

🌟Features

●95% Modal, 5% Spandex / Cotton 100% / 93% Viscose Derived From Bamboo , 7% Spendex


●This premium pajama set is made with an eco-friendly  modal fabric that is stretchy, silky, lightweight, soft, and comfy.

● Modal fibers remain soft over time and are able to withstand repeated wash and dry cycles, allowing fabrics to retain their softness.

●This pajama set is made without tags and with smooth seams for extra comfort.

●All of Vaenait Baby's Pajamas are tight-fitting and there are No-Flame Retardants.

●For child's safety, cotton sleep sets should always fit snugly. Loose fitting garment is more likely to catch fire. All of Vaenait Baby's products are strictly under Consumer Product Safety Rules.

🧺Washing Instructions:


● Suitable for machine and hand washing

● Do not use bleach.

● Do not tumble dry.

📝 Note:

● Product color might slightly differ due to device settings.

● Slight dimension differences of 1-2cm may occur due to different manual measurements.
